title: Deciding Without Pointing: A Case Study of Whether a Decision Model Localizes the Anomalies It Detects
abstract: arXiv:2611.21995v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Decision models can answer a typed question about an image with a probability per option, without generating text. In our case study of Clef-flash (post-trained Qwen3.5-9B backbone) on industrial inspection benchmarks, we ask whether it localizes the anomalies it detects. We obtained uneven results with zero-shot detection: per-category image AUROC 0.924 on MVTec AD and 0.668 on MVTec AD 2. On the former, the decision head's routing attention produces 0.391 mean per-image pixel AUROC, and hiding the image tokens from it leaves detection unchanged. The multimodal LLM's backbone attention does point at the defect, however it falls below a center prior when we change question. It falls below chance if we remove textual context in the question, partly due to backbone attention leaving the object, while the head's map hardly changes. The backbone's states carry the location when probed with normal images, on the test-split images, however,

translated_title: 无指向的决策：决策模型能否定位其所检测异常的案例研究
translated_abstract: 决策模型可以通过对每个选项输出概率来回答关于图像的类型化问题，而无需生成文本。在我们对Clef-flash（经后训练的Qwen3.5-9B骨干网络）在工业检测基准上的案例研究中，我们探究它是否能定位其检测到的异常。零样本检测结果参差不齐：在MVTec AD上每类别图像AUROC为0.924，在MVTec AD 2上为0.668。在前者上，决策头的路由注意力产生的平均每图像像素AUROC仅为0.391，并且对它隐藏图像token也不会改变检测结果。多模态大语言模型的骨干注意力确实指向缺陷区域，但当我们改变问题时，其表现会低于中心先验基线；而如果移除问题中的文本上下文，其表现甚至会低于随机水平，部分原因是骨干注意力偏离了目标物体，而此时决策头的注意力图却几乎不变。骨干网络的内部状态在用正常图像探测时能够携带位置信息，但在测试集图像上，……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该案例研究发现，决策模型Clef-flash虽在工业异常检测上表现不俗，但其决策头的注意力并不能定位所检测到的缺陷，而骨干网络的注意力定位能力在改变问题或移除文本上下文时会显著退化。
en_tdlr: This case study finds that while the decision model Clef-flash performs well at industrial anomaly detection, its decision head attention fails to localize the defects it detects, and the backbone's attention-based localization degrades substantially when the question is changed or textual context is removed.
